releases.name: v0.4.6 — Defensive theme-token fallback
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Contain missing host theme-token failures inside Flema rendering.
- Fall back from the requested semantic token to `text`, then to readable unstyled text if both lookups fail.
- Preserve MCP-owned shared rail rendering, attachment ownership, and disposal behavior.

## Release safety

- `AI PR Review` completed on the exact final PR head with 0 critical, high, or medium findings.
- The single low informational finding was answered and its conversation resolved.
- Both required `validate` checks passed.
- npm `prepublishOnly` passed typecheck, all 522 tests, build, and 207-file package verification.

## Install

```sh
pi install npm:opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.4.6
```

For Gentle Shell:

```sh
PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$HOME/.gentle-shell/agent" \
  pi install npm:opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.4.6
```

releases.name: v0.4.5 — Gentle Shell sidebar theme compatibility
releases.body:

releases.name: v0.4.3 — Reliable Gentle Shell rail cards
releases.body:
## What’s changed

- Keep Engram sidebar cards independent in Gentle Shell 4.6+ while preserving the legacy framed sidebar and overlay fallbacks.
- Contain third-party rail render and card-group failures, and clamp rows using the host TUI width functions so one bad participant cannot suppress the entire rail.
- Pin `@opentui/solid` to 0.5.9 for Node 24 fresh installs.
- Update installation examples and release-facing site metadata to 0.4.3.
- Extend the local MCP stdio smoke timeout to accommodate slower startup.

## Verification

- 513 tests passed.
- TypeScript typecheck and build passed.
- Package verification passed (207 files).
- Required GitHub CI `validate` passed on the release-preparation PR.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/oniricosistemas/flema-engram/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

## What's changed

- Refresh Gentle Shell/Pi sidebars immediately after successful Engram saves.
- Invalidate shared adapter caches before refresh and prevent stale in-flight reads from repopulating them.
- Preserve Cloud-aware project state while falling back to the newly saved local observation when Cloud is unavailable.
- Refresh the official OpenCode TUI after successful namespaced Engram save tool completions, with event deduplication and listener cleanup.
- Update installation documentation and the project site for `0.4.2`.

## Verification

- 508 tests passed
- TypeScript typecheck and build passed
- Package verification passed for 207 files
- Native RDD review approved across risk, resilience, readability, and reliability lenses

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/oniricosistemas/flema-engram/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2

releases.name: v0.4.1 — Pi global-scope compatibility and cloud-first fallback
releases.body:
# v0.4.1 — Pi global-scope compatibility and cloud-first fallback

## Highlights

- **Fix `All adapters failed` sidebar error**: accept `scope: "global"` in observation/project schemas — live Engram 3.6 returns this scope in all-project results, causing project enumeration to fail
- **Cloud-first Pi adapter**: Pi/Gentle Shell now resolves projects from cloud first, falling back to local Engram when cloud returns empty or errors
- **OpenCode unchanged**: existing `createConfiguredAdapter` local-first behavior is preserved

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/schemas/observation.ts` | Accept `scope: "global"` |
| `src/schemas/project.ts` | Accept `scope: "global"` in project scopes |
| `src/adapters/types.ts` | Extend `Observation.scope` and `ListObservationsOpts.scope` |
| `src/adapters/composite.ts` | Add `fallbackOnEmpty` option and `listProjectsAcrossAdapters` |
| `src/adapters/factory.ts` | Add `createPiConfiguredAdapter` (cloud-first) |
| `src/pi.ts` | Use `createPiConfiguredAdapter` for Pi extension |

## Verification

- Full suite: 504/504 tests pass
- TypeScript typecheck: pass
- Build: pass
- Live Gentle Shell: sidebar shows `flema-engram · OK`, `/engram-refresh` returns `Engram refreshed`

## Install

```sh
pi install npm:opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.4.1
# or for Gentle Shell:
PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$HOME/.gentle-shell/agent" pi install npm:opencode-flema-engram-sidebar@0.4.1
```
